mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post(user_id, post_title, post_content) VALUES(#{post.userId}, #{post.title}, #{post.content})
mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS id, user_id AS userId, post_title AS title, post_content AS content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, view_count AS viewCount FROM post WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1, updated_at = updated_at WHERE post_id = #{post_id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM post WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
